Title: Sacrorum conciliorum nova et amplissima collectio ... quae Joannes Dominicus Mansi evulgavit. Tomus vicesimus quintus: ab anno MCCC usque ad annum MCCCXLIV
Creator: Giovanni Domenico Mansi (ed.), after Philippe Labbe, Gabriel Cossart and Nicolas Coleti
Publisher: Facsimile reproduction for H. Welter, Paris and Leipzig, of the Venice edition of Antonio Zatta ("VENETIIS MDCCLXXXII" at file line 124); same series as the Mansi tomus 2 to 7 already in the library
Publication Date: 1782 (the edition; the title page of the facsimile reads "1903")
Rights: Public Domain
Rights basis: pd-us-by-date. The OCR title page reads "VENETIIS MDCCLXXXII" (file line 124) and, for the facsimile, "H. WELTER ... 1903" (file lines 65 to 70). The host item record gives date 1782 and carries no possible-copyright-status or licence field.
Language: lat
Source: Internet Archive item sacrorumconcilio0025joan (archive.org/details/sacrorumconcilio0025joan), full-text file sacrorumconcilio0025joan_djvu.txt, fetched directly by the Library thread, October 2026. Contributor named by the host: Internet Archive.
Provenance note: Header prepended; the host text follows unchanged. Nothing was normalised, stripped, corrected, re-spaced or retyped. OCR sampled at 5, 50 and 95 percent: Latin with the long s read as f throughout (not converted) and scattered damage; the first lines of the file are noise from a library cover.
Content note: Mansi tomus 25, the councils of 1300 to 1344. Inside the window of the Cilician world: "ACTA CONCILII SISENSIS ARMENI", the council of Sis of 1307 held on the orders of the catholicos Gregory and King Levon to unite the Armenian church with Rome (file line 12653); the letter "EPISTOLA GREGORII SISENSIS" (13480); and "ACTA CONCILII ADANENSIS", the Adana council of 1316 (61813). Also holds the council of Vienne (35558) and other councils of the period. The acts are in Latin from Armenian and Latin hands; they are the Armenian church's council record only as the editors give it. SECOND WITNESS for exact wording: check against the page images.
